name: Delegation
description: Delegation authority — lets an agent propose changes to its own setup: the agent brief and new mandates. Every proposal waits for a person's approval; nothing takes effect before it. Also lets the agent read the setup guides.
whatsNew: Says which kind of mandate the agent may propose: the profiles it may propose mandates for, and the modes (review only, or review and automatic). A proposal outside that is refused before anyone sees it. Needed for delegation on real systems, outside simulation mode. Limits are unchanged.

read_access.description: Allow the agent to read the guides for setting up a test: interview, test data, mandates, agent brief, the agent's own process, risks.

brief_daily_max.description: How many times per day the agent may propose a new agent brief. Each proposal waits for your approval.

mandate_daily_max.description: How many new mandates per day the agent may propose. Each one waits for your approval and is created only then.

brief_count_daily.description: Running daily count of brief proposals

mandate_count_daily.description: Running daily count of mandate proposals

allowed_profiles.description: Short name of the profile a mandate proposal is for

allowed_modes.description: Commitment mode a mandate proposal asks for

allowed_profiles.displayName: Profiles the agent may propose mandates for
allowed_profiles.description: Short profile names (e.g. sales, customers). A mandate proposal for any other profile is refused before a person sees it. Delegation itself can never be proposed.

allowed_modes.description: review = every action under the proposed mandate needs approval; automatic = actions run within its limits. Choose review only, or review and automatic.
